title: Sorting a mixed list
prompt: Specification: Return a new list containing all integers from the input in ascending order, followed by all strings in ascending order. The input contains only integers and strings. Four candidate implementations follow. Which candidate satisfies the specification for all valid inputs? Select one candidate.

evidence.title: Candidate executions against the test suite
evidence.body:
Each candidate was executed against the same test suite.

Test 1: assert sort_mixed_list([19,'red',12,'green','blue', 10,'white','green',1])==[1, 10, 12, 19, 'blue', 'green', 'green', 'red', 'white']
Test 2: assert sort_mixed_list([2,'b',1,'a']) == [1, 2, 'a', 'b']

candidates.code:
def sort_mixed_list(mixed_list):
    int_part = sorted([i for i in mixed_list if type(i) is int])
    str_part = sorted([i for i in mixed_list if type(i) is str])
    return str_part + int_part
